note: Paved sites (3 pull-through) at ~6,400 ft between the Pioneer Mountains Scenic Byway (FS Road 73) and a steep hill, across the road from the Wise River, Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF (Wisdom RD); about 13 mi south of MT 43. Bear lockers. No garbage service: pack it out. Distinct from the Lodgepole CG on Georgetown Lake. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated September 1, 2026) shows the campground CLOSED for the Sand Creek and Bobcat Lakes Fires (recorded as temporarily_closed). Confirmed $15/night (+$5 extra vehicle), FCFS / not reservable; added 16-day limit and season mid-May through September (closes 09-30). Sites (10, 30-ft max trailer) match the page; left as derived. Facilities left: the page says potable water is not available and drinking water 'currently unavailable', restrooms not stated. Note: FR 484 corrected to FS Road 73 per the page; trimmed of restated count, length, facilities and FCFS.
flags: Temporary closure recorded from the FS page banner ('Closed due to Sand Creek and Bobcat Lakes Fires', page updated September 1, 2026). The forest alerts page lists no current fire closure order for the area, so the closure may already have lifted (the season runs through September); re-check before next season.

Water: the FS page's Water section says 'Potable water is not available at this site' (and drinking water 'currently unavailable'); the entry's derived potable_water: true (hand pump, from the note) was left because the unavailability may be fire-related.
